summary: Brian Holmes, 26, of Ophir triggered an avalanche while descending from the Fatwa area near Waterfall Canyon on a backcountry ski tour from Trout Lake to Ophir; carried an estimated 1,000 feet down the slide and self-extricated after 10-15 minutes, mostly buried with only his face and one arm exposed; non-life-threatening injuries.
location: Fatwa area near Waterfall Canyon, Trout Lake to Ophir
responding_agency: San Miguel County Sheriff's Office SAR; Telluride Ski Patrol avalanche dog team (stood down)
notes: Alert published 11/26/2015, incident Wednesday 2015-11-25. Sheriff's deputies staged in Ophir, paged SAR volunteers, launched an Olathe Spray helicopter and activated Telluride Ski Patrol avy-dog team — all stood down when Holmes walked out to on-scene deputies ~2 p.m. His brother Alex Holmes, 27, triggered a second avalanche trying to search and skied back to Trout Lake to call for help. Surfaced via the San Miguel County SO alerts re-check (run 96). Merged the opened KVNF 2015-11-30 regional newscast headline page (Ophir brothers' avalanche headline source).
